subject: general
question:
Which of the following is not an output device?

A. Plotter

B. Speaker

C. Printer

D. Scanner
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Option 4** i.e __**D**__.

__
 
• **Plotter**: A plotter is an output device as it is a type of printer which is used to make line drawings on paper with one or more automated pens using the commands from a computer.
 
• **Speaker**: Speakers are one of the most common output devices as it produces audio output in the form of sound waves.
 
 
• Speaker is a device that converts electrical energy into sound energy.
 
 
 
• **Printer**: It is an output device as it takes the input command from the user and gives the output in the form of a texted document.
 
• **Scanner**: A **scanner is an input device**__ as it is only able to send information to the computer.
